방콕에서 만난 세계의 커피 ☕️🌏

World of Coffee Bangkok 2026에서
전 세계 커피인들과 함께 배우고,
이야기 나누고, 같은 향미를 공유하는 시간을 보냈습니다.

SCA Lecture Series,
월드 챔피언십, 글로벌 커핑 세션까지.
커피는 언어를 넘어 사람을 연결한다는 것을 다시 느낀 시간.

커피바이아카데미아는
앞으로도 더 넓은 세계의 커피를 배우고,
학생들과 그 경험을 함께 나누겠습니다.

Thank you, Bangkok 🇹🇭

World of Coffee Bangkok 2026가 마무리되었습니다.

EL BOSQUE COLOMBIA는 이번 방콕 전시회를 통해 
아시아의 많은 로스터, 바이어, 커피인들에게 
우리의 그린빈과 커피를 소개할 수 있었습니다.

부스를 찾아주시고, 
커핑과 시음을 함께해주시고, 
우리의 커피와 오리진에 관심 가져주신 모든 분들께 진심으로 감사드립니다.

우리는 단순한 수출자나 수입자가 아닙니다. 
우리는 오리진입니다.

재배부터 가공, 그리고 수출까지 
모든 과정을 EL BOSQUE가 직접 만들어갑니다.

이번 전시를 통해 많은 분들과 좋은 대화를 나눌 수 있어 정말 뜻깊은 시간이었습니다.

다시 한 번 EL BOSQUE COLOMBIA 부스를 방문해주신 모든 분들께 감사드립니다.

곧 다시 만나겠습니다.

EL BOSQUE COLOMBIA

EL BOSQUE COLOMBIA successfully completed our green coffee showcase and exhibition in Bangkok.

Thank you to everyone who visited our booth, cupped our coffees, shared conversations, and showed interest in our work and our origin.

We are not simply exporters or importers. 
We are the origin.

From harvest to processing and export, every step is done by EL BOSQUE.

It was a pleasure to share our coffees and story with people from all around Asia. 
We truly appreciate every visitor, roaster, importer, barista, and coffee professional who spent time with us during the event.

See you again soon.

You’ve been amazing, Bangkok 🇹🇭🇶🇦☕✨

World of Coffee Bangkok was truly a special one for us.

Every coffee we brought to the bar represented a part of who we are, the origins we love, the producer relationships we deeply value, and the roast style we’re proud to share with the coffee community.

Over the past few days, we’ve shared countless cups, conversations, laughs, and unforgettable moments with people from all around the world. Seeing everyone connect with Harvest and spend time with us has meant more than words can describe.

To everyone who stopped by the booth, supported us, asked questions, shared stories, or simply enjoyed a cup with us, thank you. Your energy and love made this experience unforgettable.

Grateful for every moment, every conversation, and every cup shared together.

Until next time, Bangkok 🤍☕

#WorldOfCoffee #WorldOfCoffeeBangkok #SpecialtyCoffee

WOC Bangkok Wrap-up，Flavor is the Compass 🚢

The World of Coffee Bangkok journey has come to a close. At the BITEC venue, we gathered profound feedback regarding flavor innovation and user interaction. 🔚

- The Highlight: Our Orange Rooibos Tea became a major talking point, with its high-fidelity flavor profile taking center stage. 🍊

- The Aesthetic: Saturnbird’s iconic coffee mini-cups became a viral sensation, drawing crowds with their color aesthetics and portable design. 📸

We are deeply grateful for every insightful conversation centered on quality. Oniplane will continue to serve the market with consistent, high-standard performance.

See you next time, Khop Khun Kha! 🙏✨

Huge thanks to Squeaky for making the success of World of Coffee possible.
Thank you for offering Helfezi a space and for helping bring the Thai coffee community even closer together. Your support means so much and it shows how strong and connected this industry can be when passionate people come together.
The local market is asking for better, more durable, long-life grinding discs — and together we’re moving toward that future.
A very special THANK YOU SO MUCH to BENZ and ART for your trust, energy, and support. We are grateful to be building this journey with you.
The best is yet to come. ☕✨
